newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse sees lower prices, turnover.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse sees lower prices, turnover.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse saw lacklustre trading on Thursday, when most prices sagged and turnover slipped some 8.5 million lei to 50.1 million.
"Thin demand, insignificant interest from small investors. This is what characterised today's session," said a trader.
Brokers said they expected trading to pick up in the near future as more companies will join in trading.
"News of six or seven companies having applied for a bourse quotation has travelled fast. Investors are waiting for the fresh stocks before committing more money," one broker said.

Bursa de Valori Bucuresti on Thursday announced seven companies -- including a precission tools manufacturer and a sugar products maker -- had applied for a listing but did not say when it expected trading in the new shares to start.
Thursday's session was once again dominated by state fertiliser maker Azomures SA, which took some 70 percent of the overall turnover.

Two independent value-weighted indexes on Thursday showed falls from the previous session. The VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities company, was 1.2 percent down and the BIG, compiled by Bucharest Investment Group SA brokerage house was 1.6 percent lower. Their base was 1,000 points last November.
